models.title: AI model configuration
models.subtitle: Call parameters, main model, search agent, context compression, embeddings

chat.label: Main model (Chat)
chat.weakNote: The weak flag is set per model (kb.chat.default-model.weak, kb.chat.models[].weak) and affects only how much of the runScript handbook goes into the system prompt: a weak model also gets the tutorial half with worked examples, a strong one gets the kb and limits reference alone. Defaults to true.

searchCodebase.label: Search agent (searchCodebase)
searchCodebase.allowedToolsEmpty: The list is empty — the agent can call nothing

search.title: Knowledge base search
search.subtitle: Limits and thresholds of keyword, semantic and hybrid search

tools.title: Tools and modes
tools.subtitle: What the assistant can do beyond the built-in code and document search

modes.label: Assistant modes
modes.empty: No modes configured — only the “no mode” option is available.

git.label: Repository file edits
git.readOnlyNote: Editing is enabled in the configuration, but the working tree is not writable (read-only mount), so createFile/editFile are not exposed to the model.

scripts.title: Scripts (runScript)
scripts.subtitle: The sandbox the model walks the repository in, its budgets, and a test run

status.label: Status
status.editActive: kb.edit / kb.create bound into the sandbox
status.disabledNote: The tool is off (kb.script.enabled=false) — the model is never told about scripts, and the test run below is refused.
status.readOnlyNote: Script edits are enabled in the configuration but have no effect: kb.git.edit-enabled and a writable working tree are also required.

limits.label: Per-run budgets
limits.note: The budgets bound the backend, not the model's context: only the returned value and the log ever reach it. A repeat kb.* call with the same arguments is answered from the run's cache and spends nothing.

globs.label: File visibility
globs.denyEmpty: Not set — nothing is hidden on top of .gitignore
globs.allowEmpty: Not set — every tracked file is visible

bench.label: Test run
bench.note: The script runs on the same engine and under the same limits as the model's, but always read-only: kb.edit and kb.create are not bound. The body runs as a function body — return the result with return.
bench.disabledError: Scripts are disabled in the configuration (kb.script.enabled=false).
bench.requestError: Could not run the script — see the server log for details.

index.title: Semantic index
index.subtitle: Re-indexing of knowledge base embeddings and background queue settings

reindex.title: Re-index all documents
reindex.desc: Rebuilds embeddings for all documents. Search may be slower while the index is rebuilding.
reindex.error: Failed to start re-indexing. Try again later.

bulk.title: Bulk operations
bulk.subtitle: Export, import and batch processing of documents

export.title: Export all documents
export.desc: Exports the tree to the server folder (DOCUMENTS_EXPORT_PATH): Markdown{{meta}}, folder structure is preserved
export.done: Documents exported to the server export folder.
export.error: Export failed. Make sure DOCUMENTS_EXPORT_PATH is set.

archive.title: Download everything as an archive
archive.desc: A zip of the whole tree in the same layout as the export. No server folder needed: the archive is assembled straight into the response.

diff.title: Compare the folder with the database
diff.desc: A read-only run: shows what an import would change without writing anything. Entries are matched by the file paths the export writes.
diff.error: Comparison failed. Make sure DOCUMENTS_EXPORT_PATH is set and the folder exists.
diff.empty: No differences — the export folder matches the database.

import.title: Import the selection
import.desc: Writes the selected comparison entries to the database: {{count}} selected. Relative links are turned back into internal ones.
import.doneCountsWithFailed: Created: {{created}} · updated: {{updated}} · deleted: {{deleted}} · failed: {{failed}} — the reasons are in the log below.
import.error: Import failed. See the server log for details.
import.deleteMissing: Delete selected "missing" entries from the database ({{count}})

log.title: What the import did (nodes: {{count}})
log.dropped: …and {{count}} more — the start of the log is shown, every failure is.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Profile, database, indexed repository and access

security.label: Access
security.note: The single user is configured in kb.security. The password is not shown here and is never returned by the API.

phrases.subtitle: Ready-made prompts above the input field in an empty chat
